verdict.rationale: Paychex's own developer API overview lists a 'Webhooks' section alongside its REST/OAuth 2.0 API docs, so the product documents webhooks as a first-party capability. The pack gives no detail on what that capability covers. Missing for 10: documented event catalog covering payroll processed, employee onboarded and payment failed; subscription/registration mechanics; payload and delivery/retry semantics; independent or hands-on corroboration.
